description: 西西里防御 B20 — 什么是半开放线

intro.popup_en: Open Files, Lesson 1: Black's first move ...c5 leaves the c-file without black pawns. A semi-open file has pawns for only one side; for Black, the c-file becomes a natural route for a rook. Place a rook on c8 to control it.
intro.popup:
什么是半开放线 第1课

黑方第一手c5！
c列从此无黑兵

半开放线=只有一方无兵的列
黑方c线是天然的车通道！

把车放到c8，控制c线！

outro.popup_en: After ...c5 and ...cxd4, the c-file is open for Black. With no black pawns on the file, a rook on c8 controls this strategic route and applies pressure. When a semi-open file appears, place a rook on it and use it to attack.
outro.popup:
半开放线小结
✅ c5→cxd4：c线完全打通
✅ 黑方c列无兵=半开放线
✅ 车放c8 = 控制战略通道

核心公式：
有半开放线→车放上去→施压对方！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center, one of White's most common opening moves.
moves.popup:
e4占中心
这是白方最常见的第一手

moves.popup_en: ...c5! A semi-open file is created: Black has no pawns on the c-file, giving the rook a natural route.
moves.popup:
c5！半开放线诞生！
从此c列再无黑兵
黑方c线=半开放线！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and controls d4 and e5.

moves.popup:
d6稳固中心
为Nf6做准备

moves.popup_en: d4! White challenges the center and attacks the c5-pawn, aiming to open the position.
moves.popup:
d4！白方反中心
挑战c5，试图打开中心

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4! Black exchanges and fully opens the c-file. There are no black pawns from c8 to c1, creating a clear rook highway.
moves.popup:
cxd4！黑方兑换！
c线完全打通！
从c8到c1没有任何黑兵！

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 places White's knight in the center. White has central control, while Black has the open c-file.
moves.popup:
Nxd4白马占中心
白方有中心控制优势

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4, adding pressure.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展马
攻击e4，施加压力

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and supports the center.
...a6! Black prevents White's knight from jumping to b5, a typical Sicilian precaution.
moves.popup:
a6防守！
防止白马跳b5
西西里经典小手段

moves.popup_en: Be2 develops safely and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
Be2稳固发展
准备入城

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces the center and prepares to develop the bishop.
moves.popup:
e6稳固中心
为象发展做准备

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and prepares a kingside plan.
moves.popup:
O-O白方入城
王安全，准备翼翼进攻

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and prepares Black to castle.
Be3 develops and supports the knight on d4.
...O-O secures Black's king. Black can now bring a rook to e8 or c8.
moves.popup:
O-O黑方入城！
王安全，Re8或Rc8即将部署

moves.popup_en: f4! White begins a kingside advance and prepares f5.
moves.popup:
f4！白方翼翼进攻
准备f5推进

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops, attacks White's knight on d4, and contests the center. Black is also ready to occupy the c-file with ...Rc8.
moves.popup:
Nc6发展马
攻击d4马，争夺中心
同时Rc8即将占领c线！

moves.popup_en: Nb3 retreats the knight from d4. Black can now play ...Rc8 and fully control the semi-open c-file.
moves.popup:
Nb3撤退
白马离开d4
黑方现在可以Rc8！
完全控制c线半开放线！
